hooks.command: echo 0 > /tmp/saiska-search-count; echo 0 > /tmp/saiska-edit-count; echo '{"systemMessage": "IRON RULES: 1) Start EVERY response with 兄弟 2) Scan skills before responding 3) Before push: scan internal files 4) Before claiming done: verify 5) UI changes: screenshot → Mimo review 6) New .py: write tests 7) Community files current 8) Bug fails 3x → WebSearch → ask Mimo. Counters reset."}'
echo '{"systemMessage": "START WITH 兄弟. SCAN SKILLS. CHECK CLAUDE.md."}'

cd /Users/cengchenyicheng/saisika && INTERNAL=$(git ls-files | grep -E 'CLAUDE\.md$|\.spec$|electron-builder|\.mcp\.json$|\.vscode/|\.DS_Store|keygen\.py|saisika/' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$INTERNAL" ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"WARNING: Internal files detected in tracked files:\\n$INTERNAL\\n\\nProceeding but review before public release.\", \"continue\": true}"; else echo '{}'; fi

C=/tmp/saiska-search-count; N=$(cat $C 2>/dev/null || echo 0); N=$((N+1)); echo $N > $C; if [ $N -ge 3 ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"ESCALATE: $N WebSearches in this session. 3-failure rule: stop searching, ask Mimo instead (python3 scripts/ask-mimo.py 'your problem')\", \"continue\": true}"; else echo '{}'; fi

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; python3 -c "import py_compile; py_compile.compile('$f', doraise=True)" 2>&1 && echo '{}' || echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Python syntax error in $f — fix before committing\", \"continue\": true}"; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */services/*.py|*/adapters/*.py|*/utils/bilingual.py) TEST="tests/test_$(basename $f .py).py"; if [ ! -f "$TEST" ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"No test file for $f. Write tests at $TEST before committing.\", \"continue\": true}"; else echo '{}'; fi;; *) echo '{}';; esac; }
cd /Users/cengchenyicheng/saisika && python3 -m pytest tests/ -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && echo '{}' || echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Tests FAILED — fix before committing.\", \"continue\": true}"

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */app/frontend/*) cd /Users/cengchenyicheng/saisika/app/frontend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -5 && echo '{}' || echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"TypeScript errors detected — fix before building\", \"continue\": true}";; *) echo '{}';; esac; }

cd /Users/cengchenyicheng/saisika && CHANGES=$(git status --short 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$CHANGES" -gt 0 ]; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"$CHANGES uncommitted file(s) in working tree. Remember to commit before ending session.\"}"; else echo '{}'; fi
